head.briefing: A tiny round of work for trying the panel out. Nothing here matters and nothing outside this folder may be touched.

cards.title: Write the note
cards.prompt: Create a file called note.txt in this project. Write one single sentence into it about {{topic}}. Then say the absolute path of the file you wrote.
cards.dod: note.txt exists and holds one sentence about the topic.

cards.title: Read it back
cards.prompt: Read the file at [[note]] and reply with exactly the sentence it contains, and nothing else.

slots.name: note
slots.description: The absolute path the previous card said it wrote

cards.dod: The reply is the sentence that is in the file.
